acceptanceCriteria: The Tasks developer (or release) channel publishes a linux/amd64 corvint-tasks archive covered by SHA256SUMS, with qualification limits stated.
A fresh Linux host can download, checksum-verify and run `corvint-tasks version` and `corvint-tasks roadmap` against an existing .taskman store read-only.
body: Observed 2026-10-19. Projects such as beamfall/oscillux require their native Corvint Tasks store (.taskman/) for ticket reads, claims and completion. Claude Code cloud sessions run on Linux. The latest Tasks developer release tasks-dev-20260929.2 publishes only corvint-tasks_darwin_arm64.tar.gz plus SHA256SUMS, while Core v1.0.0-rc.2 publishes linux_amd64/linux_arm64. A cloud session therefore cannot install a verified corvint-tasks and must fall back to read-only JSON inspection, which the project contract forbids for mutations. Local reference: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.676 on darwin. Expected: a checksum-pinned linux/amd64 (and ideally linux/arm64) corvint-tasks archive on the Tasks channel, or a documented supported install path for Linux hosts. Actual: darwin_arm64 only. Related but distinct: V1-0374 (linux/amd64 Core qualification workflow), V1-0911 (Linux qualification of Tasks scale work).
title: Publish linux/amd64 corvint-tasks archives so cloud (Linux) agent sessions can use native Tasks stores
